```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

``` {r}
library(data.table)

input_folder <- "Y:/Ryan Armstrong/Pollution Modeling/Ambiant Air Pollution/Input Data/Merged Air Pollution Data"
output_folder <- "Y:/Ryan Armstrong/Pollution Modeling/Ambiant Air Pollution/Input Data/Monthly Aggregated Air Pollution Data"

dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

codes <- c("44201", "42602", "42401", "42101")

for (code in codes) {
  
  in_file <- file.path(input_folder, paste0("merged_", code, ".csv"))
  
  if (!file.exists(in_file)) {
    message("Missing file: ", in_file)
    next
  }
  
  message("Reading: ", in_file)
  dt <- fread(in_file)
  
  # date conversion
  dt[, Date.Local := as.Date(Date.Local)]
  
  # keep only 2000-2019
  dt <- dt[!is.na(Date.Local) & as.integer(format(Date.Local, "%Y")) %in% 2000:2019]
  
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    message("No rows for 2021-2026 in ", in_file)
    next
  }
  
  # filter sample duration where needed
  if ("Sample.Duration" %in% names(dt)) {
    
    # REPLACE these exact values if your labels differ
    if (code == "42101") {
      dt <- dt[Sample.Duration == "8-HR RUN AVG END HOUR" | Sample.Duration == "8-HR RUN AVG BEGIN HOUR"]
    }
    
    if (code == "42401") {
      dt <- dt[Sample.Duration == "1 HOUR"]
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    message("No rows left after Sample.Duration filter for ", code)
    next
  }
  
  # if multiple rows still exist for same site/date, keep first after sorting
  sort_cols <- intersect(
    c("State.Code", "County.Code", "Site.Num", "Date.Local", "POC"),
    names(dt)
  )
  setorderv(dt, sort_cols)
  
  dt <- dt[, .SD[1], by = .(State.Code, County.Code, Site.Num, Date.Local)]
  
  # create year/month
  dt[, year := as.integer(format(Date.Local, "%Y"))]
  dt[, month := as.integer(format(Date.Local, "%m"))]
  
  # monthly aggregation with lat/long kept
  monthly <- dt[
    ,
    .(
      monthly_mean = mean(Arithmetic.Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      days_with_data = sum(!is.na(Arithmetic.Mean))
    ),
    by = .(
      State.Code,
      County.Code,
      Site.Num,
      Latitude,
      Longitude,
      year,
      month
    )
  ]
  
  monthly[, year_month := sprintf("%04d-%02d", year, month)]
  monthly[, pollutant_code := code]
  
  setcolorder(monthly, c(
    "pollutant_code",
    "State.Code", "County.Code", "Site.Num",
    "Latitude", "Longitude",
    "year", "month", "year_month",
    "monthly_mean", "days_with_data"
  ))
  
  out_file <- file.path(output_folder, paste0("monthly_", code, "_2000_2019.csv"))
  fwrite(monthly, out_file)
  
  message("Saved: ", out_file)
}

message("Done.")

```
